reconciled_claims.historical_formulation: Kẹt sợi/dây kim loại tạo biến đổi độ cứng là một nguyên lý cơ học mới.
reconciled_claims.current_formulation: Tunable stiffness via metallic wire and fiber jamming is established in literature (Bai et al. 2022, Zhang & Yao 2026); no device-level or physical-existence novelty survives.
reconciled_claims.supporting_evidence: Exploratory soft actuation concepts combining wire jamming with soft matrices.
reconciled_claims.counter_evidence: Bai et al. (2022, DOI: 10.3390/app12073582) demonstrated tunable stiffness using wire jamming in soft actuators; Zhang & Yao (2026, DOI: 10.5194/ms-17-481-2026) demonstrated fiber jamming chains.
reconciled_claims.what_is_established: Tunable stiffness through frictional jamming of wires and fibers is established prior art.
reconciled_claims.what_is_not_established: Any physical-existence novelty for wire/fiber jamming in variable-stiffness mechanics.
reconciled_claims.residual_risk: None; claim is definitively closed and abandoned.

reconciled_claims.historical_formulation: Kẹt bằng áp suất dương là cơ chế cơ học mới.
reconciled_claims.current_formulation: Positive-pressure jamming is established prior art (Liu et al. 2021, Zhang & Yao 2026); positive fluid pressure is an actuation method/boundary condition, not a novel mechanics principle.
reconciled_claims.supporting_evidence: Soft robotic chamber designs utilizing positive pressurization.
reconciled_claims.counter_evidence: Liu et al. (2021, DOI: 10.1109/LRA.2021.3097255) demonstrated positive-pressure jamming structures up to 200 kPa for wearable robotics; Zhang & Yao (2026, DOI: 10.5194/ms-17-481-2026) applied positive pressure up to 300 kPa.
reconciled_claims.what_is_established: Positive-pressure confinement to generate frictional jamming is established prior art.
reconciled_claims.what_is_not_established: Any claim that positive pressure creates a novel jamming principle.
reconciled_claims.residual_risk: None; claim is definitively closed and abandoned.

reconciled_claims.claim_label: SMA and Jamming Co-existence in Variable-Stiffness Structure
reconciled_claims.historical_formulation: Kết hợp SMA và jamming trong cùng thiết bị là mới.
reconciled_claims.current_formulation: Combining shape memory alloys with jamming mechanisms is pre-empted (Takashima et al. 2022-2026, Matsumoto et al. 2024); device-level co-existence is not novel.
reconciled_claims.supporting_evidence: Soft actuator concepts combining active thermal SMA actuation and passive jamming.
reconciled_claims.counter_evidence: Takashima et al. (2022, DOI: 10.20965/jrm.2022.p0466) built variable-stiffness links using shape memory materials and jamming; Matsumoto et al. (2024, DOI: 10.1299/mej.24-00130) utilized R-phase Ti-Ni wire jamming; Takashima et al. (2026).
reconciled_claims.what_is_established: Co-existence of SMA elements and jamming media in variable stiffness structures is established.
reconciled_claims.what_is_not_established: Any device-level combination novelty for SMA + jamming.
reconciled_claims.residual_risk: None; claim is definitively closed and abandoned.

reconciled_claims.historical_formulation: Nguồn áp suất tích hợp/nhỏ gọn cung cấp cho cơ cấu kẹt là đóng góp mới.
reconciled_claims.current_formulation: Onboard pressure sources (micropumps, motorized syringes, miniature compressors) are engineering implementation choices (Huynh et al. 2022, Wang et al. 2024); packaging does not constitute scientific novelty.
reconciled_claims.supporting_evidence: Portable soft robot prototypes with onboard pneumatic systems.
reconciled_claims.counter_evidence: Huynh et al. (2022, DOI: 10.1038/s41467-022-31128-4) demonstrated untethered soft robots with integrated pumps; Wang et al. (2024, DOI: 10.1108/IR-11-2023-0305) implemented piston-like particle jamming with internal miniature actuators.
reconciled_claims.what_is_established: Compact/onboard pressure actuation is standard robotic hardware integration.
reconciled_claims.what_is_not_established: Any mechanics novelty arising from pump miniaturization or packaging.
reconciled_claims.residual_risk: None; claim is closed and expunged from the scientific core.

reconciled_claims.claim_label: Superelastic NiTi Wires Themselves as Frictional Jamming Medium
reconciled_claims.historical_formulation: Dây NiTi siêu đàn hồi tự thân làm môi trường ma sát trượt tạo biến đổi độ cứng.
reconciled_claims.current_formulation: Physical existence of inter-wire friction and contact slip in multi-wire NiTi cables and bundles is established (Carboni et al. 2015, Vahidi et al. 2022, Reedlunn et al. 2013); existence of inter-wire contact friction is not novel.
reconciled_claims.supporting_evidence: Damping and stiffness modulation in multi-wire superelastic assemblies.
reconciled_claims.counter_evidence: Carboni et al. (2015, DOI: 10.1061/(ASCE)EM.1943-7889.0000852) experimentally characterized inter-wire friction and hysteresis in Nitinol wire strands; Vahidi et al. (2022, DOI: 10.1080/15376494.2021.1955313) modeled multiwire NiTi cables with inter-wire Coulomb friction.
reconciled_claims.what_is_established: Inter-wire friction in NiTi multiwire bundles is established prior art.
reconciled_claims.what_is_not_established: Any physical-existence novelty for inter-wire friction in NiTi.
reconciled_claims.residual_risk: None at existence level; mechanism absorbed into H0b baseline null model.

reconciled_claims.claim_label: Positive-Pressure Confinement of Superelastic NiTi Wire Bundle
reconciled_claims.historical_formulation: Áp suất dương trực tiếp giam giữ bó dây NiTi tạo ra nguyên lý cơ học mới.
reconciled_claims.current_formulation: Confining pressure is a time-varying external traction boundary condition (σ · n = -p(t) n), not an independent constitutive law; narrowed to an experimental control protocol/boundary condition.
reconciled_claims.supporting_evidence: Active chamber pressure allows dynamic modulation of the normal contact force distribution across bundle layers.
reconciled_claims.counter_evidence: Continuum beam contact formulations (Tjahjanto et al. 2017, Xin Liu 2004, Barsi et al. 2025) naturally accommodate external radial/transverse pressure tractions without requiring new field equations.
reconciled_claims.what_is_established: External pressure modulates inter-wire contact normal forces as a classical boundary condition.
reconciled_claims.what_is_not_established: That pressure modulation constitutes a new constitutive principle or distinct mechanics law.
reconciled_claims.residual_risk: Pressure-to-normal-force transmission (p -> f_n) is uncertain due to membrane hoop stress, void arching, and bundle flattening.

reconciled_claims.claim_label: Coupling of NiTi Superelasticity, Inter-Wire Friction, Pressure, and Bending Stiffness
reconciled_claims.historical_formulation: Ghép cặp siêu đàn hồi NiTi, trượt ma sát, áp suất và độ cứng uốn là một hiện tượng cơ học mới chưa từng được biết đến.
reconciled_claims.current_formulation: Coupled superelasticity and inter-wire friction exists in literature (Carboni & Lacarbonara 2016, Vahidi et al. 2022); narrowed strictly to a model-discrimination question: does a locked H0b model (standard nonlinear NiTi constitutive law + Coulomb friction) fail to predict pressure-controlled bending, thereby requiring an H1 coupling law?
reconciled_claims.supporting_evidence: Coexistence of Martensitic transformation and frictional stick-slip under active confinement presents complex nonlinear hysteresis and tangent stiffness variation.
reconciled_claims.counter_evidence: Vahidi et al. (2022) successfully reproduced coupled behavior in NiTi wire ropes using standard Auricchio constitutive model + penalty Coulomb friction in Abaqus without any new coupling law.
reconciled_claims.what_is_established: Coupled response can be phenomenologically reproduced; H0a (constant modulus) is refuted during transformation.
reconciled_claims.what_is_not_established: That H0b is insufficient; H1 is unproven; no decisive model failure demonstrated.
reconciled_claims.residual_risk: H0b may completely explain all experimental data, killing the distinct MP1 scientific claim.

reconciled_claims.historical_formulation: Cơ cấu xi lanh/piston SMA cấp áp suất kẹt là đóng góp khoa học mới của luận văn.
reconciled_claims.current_formulation: SMA-actuated pistons/pumps are implementation mechanisms (Wang et al. 2024, Pierce & Mascaro 2013); engineering actuator substitution, not a mechanics contribution.
reconciled_claims.supporting_evidence: Thermal activation of SMA wire to drive a piston or syringe.
reconciled_claims.counter_evidence: Pierce & Mascaro (2013, DOI: 10.1109/ASME.2013.6695843) designed SMA wire pumps; Wang et al. (2024, DOI: 10.1108/IR-11-2023-0305) utilized piston actuators for particle jamming.
reconciled_claims.what_is_established: SMA actuators driving fluid displacement are prior art.
reconciled_claims.what_is_not_established: Any fundamental mechanics novelty in using an SMA piston for jamming.
reconciled_claims.residual_risk: Thermal cycling latency, low efficiency, mechanical fatigue.

reconciled_targets.original_target: Dây NiTi tiếp xúc và trượt ma sát tương đối tạo độ cứng uốn.
reconciled_targets.current_target: Inter-wire frictional contact in NiTi wire bundles; closed at existence level and mapped into baseline formulation.
reconciled_targets.support: Demonstrated experimentally and numerically in Vahidi 2022, Carboni 2015, Reedlunn 2013.
reconciled_targets.threats: Direct prior art establishes inter-wire friction in NiTi cables.
reconciled_targets.remaining_scientific_value: Zero as an independent novelty target; essential baseline input to H0b.

reconciled_targets.original_target: Áp suất dương ngoài nén hướng kính bó dây kim loại/NiTi, làm đổi lực pháp tuyến và độ cứng uốn.
reconciled_targets.current_target: External positive confinement pressure as a time-varying traction boundary condition p(t).
reconciled_targets.support: Tjahjanto 2017 (radial confining pressure on cables), Liu 2021 (positive pressure jamming).
reconciled_targets.threats: Continuum mechanics naturally accepts external tractions; not a new physical law.
reconciled_targets.remaining_scientific_value: Experimental control variable to modulate contact state; zero novel constitutive value.
reconciled_targets.remaining_execution_risk: High (p -> f_n mapping error, void arching, membrane stiffness).

reconciled_targets.original_target: Ghép cặp phản ứng siêu đàn hồi NiTi với tiếp xúc/trượt, áp suất giam giữ, trễ và độ cứng.
reconciled_targets.current_target: Model discrimination: evaluate whether locked H0b fails to predict coupled response under variable pressure, requiring H1.
reconciled_targets.support: Carboni & Lacarbonara 2016, Vahidi 2022 demonstrate coupled damping and pinched hysteresis.
reconciled_targets.threats: Existing nonlinear FEM (Abaqus UMAT + Coulomb contact) may adequately explain all observations without any new coupling theory.
reconciled_targets.remaining_scientific_value: High conditional value if H0b demonstrably fails under held-out conditions; zero if H0b succeeds.
reconciled_targets.remaining_execution_risk: Critical (identifiability burden, coexistence domain limits, sensor integration).

reconciled_hypotheses.name: Naive Elastic Substitution (E = const)
reconciled_hypotheses.definition: Predicting bundle response by substituting a constant elastic modulus into standard wire rope equations.
reconciled_hypotheses.logical_guardrail: Rejection of H0a does NOT prove H1. It only proves constant modulus is inadequate during phase transformation.
reconciled_hypotheses.supporting_evidence: Reedlunn 2013, Fang 2019, Carboni 2015 show constant modulus fails once transformation starts.
reconciled_hypotheses.counter_evidence: Falsified in transformation-active regime (outer fiber strain > 0.75%).
reconciled_hypotheses.residual_uncertainty: None; refutation is robustly established in literature and mechanics.

reconciled_hypotheses.name: Existing Transformation-Aware NiTi Constitutive Model + Coulomb Contact
reconciled_hypotheses.definition: Standard phenomenological NiTi constitutive model (Auricchio / Graesser-Cozzarelli) coupled to Coulomb friction and standard continuum contact kinematics under external traction p(t).
reconciled_hypotheses.logical_guardrail: Primary competitor null hypothesis. If H0b adequately predicts response, MP1 distinct novelty is killed.
reconciled_hypotheses.counter_evidence: No simulation or experiment in repository has falsified H0b under locked calibration.
reconciled_hypotheses.residual_uncertainty: Whether H0b with locked parameters matches experimental pressure-controlled bending within declared error tolerances.

reconciled_hypotheses.name: Novel Distinct Constitutive-Contact Coupling
reconciled_hypotheses.definition: A new micro-mechanical coupling law between phase transformation kinetics and inter-wire frictional stick-slip.
reconciled_hypotheses.logical_guardrail: Cannot be inferred from H0a rejection. Requires demonstrated failure of locked H0b on held-out conditions.
reconciled_hypotheses.counter_evidence: Insufficient evidence; live only as a candidate hypothesis awaiting decisive discrimination.
reconciled_hypotheses.residual_uncertainty: Complete uncertainty; existence of distinct micro-coupling unverified.

logical_guardrails: H0a false does NOT imply H1 true
H0b is the primary live competitor null hypothesis
H1 remains an unproven candidate hypothesis with insufficient evidence
P3 / C6 is an experimental control boundary condition, not a novel mechanics law
Device-level architectural novelty (C1, C2, C3, C4, C8) is completely rejected
